conviction_note: The units have been pinned at the City Index Fifth tender price of JPY 125,000 since 2026-09-28 (offer period to 2026-11-10, no upper limit), and the period's profit and distribution were pre-released in the 2026-09-25 revision, so the results release cannot reprice the stock; the only way it moves is a change to the tender itself, and nothing points to that inside the window. So 0, with abs_move about 0.3%. The 3.77% proxy in the baseline is the 2026-09-28 jump showing up in realised vol, not a scale for this print.

It was filed 25 days after the period closed, so it is effectively the result. https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2972&b=k202609250012 (revision PDF https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260925/140120260925539836/). positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-15: no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, short_ratio 0.0 and no change. margin_ratio null in the baseline, and kabutan shows 信用倍率 '－'. No option skew exists. The run_up_20d of +19.26% is the tender premium (JPY 107,200 close on 09-25 to JPY 125,200 on 09-28), not momentum. Since then the stock has closed between 125,000 and 125,400 on every session, including 2026-10-15 when the Nikkei fell 3,318 yen (Yahoo chart https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2972.T?range=1mo&interval=1d). Nomura reported a higher holding on 2026-10-08 (kabutan n202610080750), consistent with arbitrage or tendering flow.

findings.finding: City Index Fifth (an affiliate of the former Murakami fund) is running a tender offer for all units at JPY 125,000: no upper limit, a floor of 118,732 units (25.42%), offer period 2026-09-28 to 2026-11-10, with delisting and squeeze-out intended. The REIT's board supports the offer and is neutral on whether to tender. The units have traded at JPY 125,000-125,400 since, so the 15:30 results release (a period already pre-released on 09-25) has nothing to reprice.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the tender was announced the stock has closed within -0.08% to +0.32% of the offer price on every session, including the 2026-10-13 15:30 asset-sale completion and debt-repayment notices and the 2026-10-15 index crash. On 2026-04-13 a profit downgrade with no distribution came while no tender was live, so that reaction is not comparable.
findings.why_not_priced: It is fully priced, and that is the point: spot JPY 125,100 sits on the JPY 125,000 offer price. If the market expected the print to matter, units would trade away from the offer price or turnover would rise into the release. Instead volume has faded from 33,584 units on 09-28 to 238 this morning. The finding is that the event has nothing to move, so it is sized at 0.
findings.independence: The tender announcement PDF on TDnet via kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260925/140120260925540118/), M&A Online (https://maonline.jp/news/20260925f) and the Yahoo daily tape all independently confirm the price, the period and the pin.

outside_window.finding: The City Index Fifth tender closes 2026-11-10, and success depends on reaching the 25.42% floor. ATRA and Aya Nomura (19.58%) will not tender. The previous Tosei/GIC offer at the same JPY 125,000 failed in February 2026, so the result (or a counter-bid or price bump) is the real catalyst, and it falls after this window.

baseline_tension: The baseline's lean of -0.96 comes entirely from the +19.26% run-up, but that run-up is the tender premium, so the lean's mean-reversion logic does not apply to a unit pinned at a fixed cash offer. The strongest positive the release could carry is a FP Aug-2026 beat or a higher distribution; I looked, and under a JPY 125,000 tender neither can lift the price. The tail in either direction is a tender event (bump, counter-bid or withdrawal), which nothing dates inside this window.
lessons_applied: nothing changed (rule 1 on negatives resting on a visible series and rule 2 on sign tilt do not apply to a zero; open question 3, that a prior 業績予想の修正 kills the event, is consistent with the draft)
